column3: NYCEDC is a local development corporation, not a City agency — our register types it 'Public Benefit or Development Organization'. It appears 0 times as a contracting agency and 0 times in all three capital tables (whose 26 managing agencies are the bodies holding their own capital budget lines). Its City work reaches it as a vendor: 12 contracts worth $11,183.9M, all from the Department of Small Business Services, which is its oversight agency. NOTE 12 and not 24: `contracts` holds one row per AMENDMENT, and the raw row count is 24 / $12,315.7M. Amendments RESTATE a total rather than adding to it, so the honest figures are the deduped ones - the #278 defect, which shipped twice here.
